notes: Identity independently checked: title Variety-seeking and time of day: a replication, author Giang Tue Trinh, Marketing Letters 36, 1017–1028 (2025), DOI 10.1007/s11002-025-09771-9 match the neutral replication reference. Springer version-of-record article web parse contains substantive Data, Method, Results and Discussion, not merely an abstract or preregistration. Table 1 cells and plotted figure values are omitted; only captions and Full size table/image labels are present. No PDF supplied. Replication uses a UK panel across ages, with no separately identified young-adult sample or leader/follower brand contrast. Description and p.5 locator cannot resolve target correspondence. Printed candidates (number-of-brands outcome): chocolate confectionary morning M=3.00, afternoon M=3.65, same-test p<0.05; soft drink morning M=3.72, afternoon M=4.31, same-test p<0.05; crisps morning M=1.47, afternoon M=1.51, same-test p>0.05. These are group means, not printed mean differences; no subtraction or conversion performed. Other candidate analyses are polynomial regressions across times (p<0.01 for all three categories), entropy/reversed HHI variants, and category-level variants. Panel 1097 is an individual contributor count; 135,478 is a purchase count. Neither is established as critical-test analytic N; no mutually exclusive final-group counts or N sum established. Original side, replication p, and reported_success are unassigned placeholders only.
